★★ TF-C82 (D-PP-PRAGMA-REGISTRY) — `#pragma` (C 6.10.6) + `_Pragma` (C 6.10.9) runtime witness. REWRITTEN, not replaced: as the FC15c example this witnessed the OPPOSITE claim — that every `#pragma` is consumed-and-DROPPED with no error, citing C 6.10.6p2. The citation was right and the conclusion was wrong. 6.10.6p2 licenses IGNORING a pragma; it does not license reporting nothing about one that silently relayouts memory. MEASURED with the sqlite harness's own recipe on macOS/arm64: of 189 corpus TUs, 15 reach a pragma at all, and 40 of the 112 reached lines are `#pragma pack` across 5 TUs. `sys/fcntl.h`'s `pack(4)` region makes `struct log2phys` sizeof 20 / _Alignof 4 where DSS computed 24 / 8 — a wrong-ABI struct on a live `fcntl(F_LOG2PHYS)` path.
WHAT IS WITNESSED NOW: (a) a pragma a `pragmaEffects` row CLAIMS is inert (`GCC diagnostic`, `clang diagnostic`, `mark`) is still consumed and dropped from every position — file scope, inside a function body, and via `_Pragma` including from a macro replacement list; and (b) `#pragma pack` REALLY APPLIES, with the numbers gated on the exit code. 10 numbered checks, each flipping 42 -> its own exit: 1 the offset breaker, 2 a real store/load round trip through the packed global, 3/4 sizeof+_Alignof of `log2phys` (20/4), 5 the OFFSET of `l2p_contigbytes` (4 under the cap, 8 without — the sharpest observable), 6 the `pack()` RESET arm (identical members outside the region = 24/8; if the reset leaked, 6 and 3 could not disagree), 7/8 the `pack(push,N)`/`pack(pop)` stack including the restore-to-the-OUTER-cap case, 9 the `_Pragma` operator at file scope, 10 the same operator reached through a MACRO — the halfway-state discriminator, since a directive-scan-only routing leaves 9 green and silently drops 10.
★ The `log2phys` block is VERBATIM from `$(xcrun --show-sdk-path)/usr/include/sys/fcntl.h:558-570` apart from `off_t` spelled as its Darwin definition (`long long`); that substitution sidesteps an UNRELATED gap (`<sys/cdefs.h>`'s `__asm("_" ...)` does not parse yet, so the real header cannot be included end to end) and changes nothing about the layout being measured.
★ CLANG GROUND TRUTH, not DSS's opinion: the file is clean under `/usr/bin/clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -isysroot $(xcrun --show-sdk-path)` and the clang-built binary independently exits 42. The `release` arm runs the shipped parser->semantic->codegen->native pipeline over the same source, so it also witnesses that the real optimizer PRESERVES the capped layout rather than re-laying the globals out.
